app.accessRequiredBody: This app should be protected by Cloudflare Access, but Access isn't enabled for now. Enable it in the Cloudflare dashboard — see deployment.md.

mailbox.noAccountsHint: Add your first email account to see your mailboxes here. You can connect Gmail or Outlook, or add any IMAP/SMTP account.
mailbox.selectToRead: Select a message to read it

message.moveMixedAccounts: Select messages from a single account to move
message.imagesBlockedBody: This email tried to load images from the internet. Loading them can reveal that you opened it and where you are.

accounts.label: Label
accounts.labelHint: How this account is shown in the sidebar (e.g. “Work”).
accounts.displayNameHint: The name recipients see when you send mail from this account (e.g. “John Doe”).
accounts.errOauthRequired: The mail server requires OAuth (Basic auth is disabled). Reconnect using the provider's OAuth button (Gmail/Outlook).
accounts.errAuth: Authentication failed. This account may need an app password or OAuth login.
accounts.errNetwork: Could not reach the mail server. It may be temporarily unavailable.
accounts.errTimeout: Synchronization timed out. The mail server may be slow or unreachable.
accounts.errSyncFailed: Synchronization failed. Check the server settings.
accounts.confirmDeleteAccount: Remove this account? This deletes its synced mail here.
accounts.oauthNotConfigured: Not configured — add {name} OAuth credentials to run this.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.remoteImagesHint: Emails can contain images that load from the sender's servers when you open them. Loading them can tell the sender you read the email and roughly where you are. Choose what works for you.
privacy.remoteImagesBlockHint: Block images unless you load them manually.
privacy.remoteImagesAllowHint: Load images in all emails automatically.
privacy.remoteImagesWhitelistHint: Load images only from senders you add below.
privacy.allowlistHint: Enter an email address or a whole domain. Press Enter to add it.
privacy.allowlistInvalid: Enter a valid email address or domain (e.g. name{'@'}example.com or example.com).
privacy.allowlistEmpty: No trusted senders yet. Images stay blocked until you add one.

access.title: Access security
access.hintEnabled: Every request is confirmed to come from your Cloudflare Access sign-in.
access.hintBasic: Access confirms you're signed in, but requests aren't individually checked. See the deployment guide to enable stronger checks.
access.sessionNone: No sign-in details available in this preview.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Get a push notification when new mail arrives in your inbox.
notifications.on: On — this device will be notified.
notifications.off: Off — this device won't be notified.
notifications.unsupported: Push notifications aren't supported in this browser.
notifications.notConfigured: Push isn't configured on the server.
notifications.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked by the browser. Allow them in your browser settings.
notifications.permissionDeniedBody: Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
notifications.enabledBody: You'll be notified when new mail arrives.
